purpose: PRE-REGISTERED selection rule for a replacement comparator meta (Mahmood 5 Oct: 'replace comparators'). Committed BEFORE any candidate search; candidates are judged per criterion from their own text, and the pick follows from the criteria and tie-breaks alone. How our pool compares with any candidate is NOT an input.

criteria.pass_if: the meta's full text is openly available under an open licence (PMC open-access subset, or the publisher/repository with a licence); free-to-read without a licence fails
the analysis used pools randomised controlled trials only (its own eligibility / methods statement)
the pooled analysis is in adults with primary insomnia (the registered protocol's population)
the pooled comparison is melatonin (any formulation) vs placebo
it pools sleep-onset latency on the estimand family mean difference in minutes (an SMD fails)
it prints per-trial rows for that outcome (a table, or a forest plot with counts or effects) AND a pooled result for it

tie_breaks.score: 1 = MD in minutes, objective or subjective as the meta states; 0 = other
number of trials in the pooled analysis of the protocol outcome

if_none_pass: NO_ACHIEVABLE_COMPARATOR: record the closest candidate and its single failing criterion; the topic keeps its current comparator; no criterion is relaxed after the search
selector: scripts/g1_comparator_select.py (deterministic; reads this rule and the typed candidates file)
